item_name: Rothco Beast Mode Patch With Hook Back
item_short_desc: Turn your Beast Mode on with Rothco’s Beast Mode Patch.
description: Turn your Beast Mode on with Rothco’s Beast Mode Patch. The beast mode morale patch measures 2” X 2” and includes a hook backing so you can attach it to a variety of gear, including tactical jackets, military vests, operators caps, and much more. Made from a construction of high-quality material, the military morale patch features yellow “Beast Mode” lettering, a dark green and white on/off switch, and a light and dark green background with claw marks.
